goal_intent: book for three including a coeliac guest and ask what they can eat

turns.utterance: Hello there, thank you ever so much for taking my call. I’d like to make a lunch booking for three people, please.
Thank you very much. I’d like to book for this coming Sunday at 12:30 in the afternoon. My name is Edward Naylor—shall I spell that for you?

Thank you kindly for checking. Yes, actually, my daughter is coeliac, so she can’t have gluten. Would you be able to let the kitchen know? And could you tell me a little about what’s on your gluten-free menu, just so I can reassure her?
Thank you so much, that’s very reassuring. I appreciate you passing me on, and I’ll just wait here for the details about your gluten-free options.

No, that’s all for now, thank you very much for your help and for noting my daughter’s coeliac requirement. I look forward to hearing more about the gluten-free menu when someone gets in touch. Have a lovely day! 

[END OF CALL]
